grammar.numbers: GIANT counter filling the width over a thick fill bar, in the block's accent colour
grammar.comparisons: frame splits into a navy and a gold block on a slanted seam, VS crashes into the seam, values slam in
grammar.steps: numbered lines (01, 02…): the line being said is huge, earlier ones shrink into a stacked list
grammar.change: classic change panel (MotionTrack): old value slides out, new value slides in
grammar.captionPosition: huge in the middle of the block when the stage is free, shrinks into the bottom slab when busy; English line small on the slab

skinAxes.cover: navy block + gold slab, title as a stack of upper-case slammed lines, numbers boxed
skinAxes.captions: kinetic type up to 132 px: words ghosted then slammed in as said, keywords in accent with a drawn bar, numbers boxed
skinAxes.framing: no footage: flat brand colour blocks (navy / gold / white) with a slanted contrasting slab
skinAxes.transitions: block wipes on every sentence/pause and stage beat (four directions, logo-blue leading stripe)
